card.name: Words before a building noun
card.fires_on: Small words like the, a, their, his, or first right before an expected word for a building or place, such as tabernacle, synagogue, church, warehouse or center. It appears in text about building, housing or storing things in a structure.

modes.label: Building a sacred structure
modes.description: A determiner after build, construction of, or building, just before words like Mishkan, Tabernacle, or house of worship.
modes.example: began plans to<< build>> a house of worship.

modes.label: Possessive before a place
modes.description: A possessive or ordinal before a church, synagogue, or warehouse.
modes.example: the congregation built its<< first>> synagogue in 1822.

modes.label: Shelter or community buildings
modes.description: A word in a phrase naming public buildings used as shelter.
modes.example: residents hunkered down in schools and<< community>> centers

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word facility or facilities next.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before the text names a building or facility.
